summaryZh: 川崎病研究中心研究川崎病的病因、病理生理和自然病程。中心支持临床、实验室和流行病学研究；该页面的实体是研究中心。

evidence.quote: About Kawasaki Disease Research Center The Kawasaki Disease Research Center is a joint collaboration between the Departments of Pediatrics, Medicine, and Family and Preventive Medicine and Sociology at UCSD, the Scripps Institute of Oceanography, and Rady Children's Hospital San Diego. The Program was created to help foster excellence in care for patients with Kawasaki Disease (KD) and to support clinical, laboratory, and epidemiologic investigation into the etiology, pathophysiology, and natural history of the disease. About Research For Parents News Contact Giving Honoring the Gordon and Marilyn Macklin Foundation Philanthropy is a critical piece of the funding mosaic that fuels research at the Kawasaki Disease Research Center. Over the years, the unwavering support of the Gordon and Marilyn Macklin Foundation has enabled a comprehensive array of research initiatives. Challenge Grants have included funding for projects to track health outcomes in adults after KD, diagnostic test research, genetic analysis, and research to track the aerosols that may trigger KD. The Gordon and Marilyn Macklin Foundation Endowed Chair in Kawasaki Disease Care and Research, in recognition of Brooke Dawn , survivor, is ensuring that advances in care through basic science and clinical research focused on KD will continue in perpetuity to improve the lives of those affected by this mysterious disease. Read RCH Foundation Press Release
